Looping in engineering notes from the triage run I kicked off this morning. Summary:
- Root cause: SAML auth header ordering + intermittent keepalive (client resets) causing our handshake validation to fail when the remote side drops during rekey.
- Repro steps attached; a quick patch to re-order header acceptance and a slightly more forgiving keepalive window fixes the repro locally.
- Work effort: ~3-5 developer hours + one short validation run in staging.

Ask for Sales Ops: please confirm we can do a 2-week trial extension (no billing impact) and approve a $500 sandbox credit. We should attach a standard conditional note: credits are one-time and require the working session to proceed (to avoid open-ended top-ups).
